cohort: The study participants were women aged 18-40 years of Caucasoid morphological subtype ethnicity in Northern India, consisting of cases with preterm birth and controls with term neonate deliveries.
finding: Increased TLR4 mRNA levels were found to be associated with preterm birth, while no association was observed between TLR4 (Asp299 Gly, Thr399 Ill) and TNF-a (-308G/A) gene polymorphisms and preterm birth.
gest_age: Cases: <37 weeks gestation; Controls: term neonate
